mainEntity.name: Can casement windows be installed in any room of the house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Casement windows are versatile and can be installed in most rooms, including kitchens, bathrooms, living areas, and bedrooms. They are particularly well-suited for hard-to-reach places, such as above sinks or countertops, because their crank operation eliminates the need to push or pull. However, it's important to consider external factors, like walkways or patios, where an outward-opening sash might create an obstruction. Your Hometelligent Inc. consultant can help assess the best window types for each specific location in your Alameda or Emeryville home.
